fact: On 18 March 2022 Togo's state company SIN and CSquared announced a joint venture to operate Equiano and the existing Communauté Electrique du Bénin (CEB) terrestrial fibre networks on Togolese territory, offered open access to regional operators.
title: Togo Welcomes Google's historic 'Equiano' Subsea Cable in a Partnership with CSquared that will Transform the Country's Broadband Landscape
